members.name: Aanya Sharma
members.bio: Aanya is a highly motivated Placement Coordinator dedicated to bridging the gap between talent and opportunity. With a keen eye for detail, she manages recruiter relations and ensures a smooth hiring process for all students.

members.name: Rohan Mehta
members.bio: Rohan leads the outreach efforts, expanding the university's corporate network. He specializes in establishing new partnerships and bringing top-tier companies to campus.

members.name: Priya Iyer
members.bio: Priya is the creative force behind PlaceCom's events and communications. She organizes workshops, mock interviews, and ensures students are well-prepared for their placement journeys.

members.name: Karan Singh
members.bio: Karan manages the technical infrastructure and operations for the placement committee. He streamlines data flows and ensures the placement portal runs flawlessly during peak recruitment seasons.

members.name: Soham Tulsyan
members.bio: Soham drives the technological vision of the team, building scalable solutions to handle complex placement workflows. His expertise lies in web development, system architecture, and automation.
